tasks.instruction: Raise your hand if you've eaten a creemee standing in a parking lot.
tasks.fakerTrap: Real yeses fire instantly with a grin of recognition; the faker's hand drifts up a beat late, tracking the room.

tasks.instruction: Point at whoever you think got up earliest today.
tasks.fakerTrap: Insiders point from actual small-talk intel; the faker's finger leaves last, following wherever the crowd swings.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for how many creemees you've had this summer.
tasks.fakerTrap: There's no safe number to fake: a zero looks like a tourist and a ten invites flavor questions the faker can't answer.

tasks.instruction: Strike the pose of someone waiting for a Church Street bus in January.
tasks.fakerTrap: Insiders converge on the same details — the hunch, the pocket hands, the thousand-yard stare — while the faker shivers theatrically at nothing.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand if you've ever waved at a boat you didn't know.
tasks.fakerTrap: The room splits unpredictably, so there's no safe majority to copy — the faker has to commit blind.

tasks.instruction: Point at the person most likely to befriend a moose.
tasks.fakerTrap: The pod converges on its obvious gentle soul; a faker guessing cold tends to pick the loudest person instead.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for how many houseplants you've ever killed.
tasks.fakerTrap: Honest counts come with a wince or a proud little nod; a flat, reactionless three is a guess.

tasks.instruction: Strike the pose of someone tasting maple syrup right off the evaporator.
tasks.fakerTrap: The local version is reverent — eyes closed, near-religious; a faker plays generic yum and it reads as pizza, not syrup.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand if you own more than one winter hat.
tasks.fakerTrap: Every local hand should fly up at once, so the slowest, most watchful hand in the pod is the tell.

tasks.instruction: Point at whoever's shoes have seen the most mud.
tasks.fakerTrap: There's a checkable answer at everyone's feet — a faker who points without glancing down first is guessing.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for how many umbrellas you own but never use.
tasks.fakerTrap: The comedy is in the specificity — insiders can say where each umbrella lives, and the faker can't.

tasks.instruction: Freeze like you just heard your name called at a coffee counter.
tasks.fakerTrap: It's a startle pose — the head snap is the whole thing — and a faker who eases into position missed the point.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand if you've apologized to an inanimate object this week.
tasks.fakerTrap: Honest hands come up mid-laugh at the specific memory; the faker raises a hand with nothing behind the eyes.

tasks.instruction: Point at the person you'd trust to parallel park in a snowstorm.
tasks.fakerTrap: Insiders commit fast to a confident-driver read; a late finger that settles on whoever's collecting votes is following, not judging.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for how many times you hit snooze this morning.
tasks.fakerTrap: Numbers appear instantly because everyone knows theirs; the faker's fingers unfold one at a time while they invent a morning.

tasks.instruction: Pose like you're holding an invisible creemee that's melting fast.
tasks.fakerTrap: The melt forces urgency — insiders chase a racing drip down the cone hand; a faker holds a calm invisible object like a statue.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand, then keep it up only if you've ever lost one glove and kept wearing the other.
tasks.fakerTrap: It's a two-beat instruction — the faker doesn't know a second beat is coming, so watch whose hand wobbles when the others drop or hold.

tasks.instruction: Point at the tallest person in the pod, but do it as slowly as you can.
tasks.fakerTrap: The answer is obvious but the slowness is the instruction — one normal-speed point is the giveaway.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for how many times you've been to the farmers market this year, rounding down.
tasks.fakerTrap: The rounding-down rule is in the instruction — a suspiciously precise seven belongs to someone who never heard it.

tasks.instruction: Strike the pose of a leaf peeper who just spotted THE tree.
tasks.fakerTrap: Insiders aim the invisible phone up at canopy height; the faker photographs something at eye level like it's a menu.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand if you've taken a photo of the lake this month.
tasks.fakerTrap: Insiders can name the spot if anyone asks; a faker's raised hand invites exactly one follow-up question they can't survive.

tasks.instruction: Point at whoever laughed most recently.
tasks.fakerTrap: It requires having actually paid attention thirty seconds ago; the faker points at the smiliest face instead of the true last laugh.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for how many states you've lived in.
tasks.fakerTrap: Every number carries an automatic follow-up — which ones? — and insiders answer without blinking.

tasks.instruction: Pose like you're crossing mud-season mud in your nicest shoes.
tasks.fakerTrap: The real pose is all tiptoe and dread, weight on the heels; a faker takes one generic big step with none of the fear.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand halfway if you sort of know how to ice skate.
tasks.fakerTrap: The half-raise is the instruction — a full confident arm is the mark of someone guessing at what everyone was told.

tasks.instruction: Point at the ceiling, then at your own shoes.
tasks.fakerTrap: It's a fixed two-part sequence, so the faker runs a half-second behind on both moves like bad choreography.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for how many mosquito bites you're currently ignoring.
tasks.fakerTrap: Real answers come with an involuntary glance at the ankle in question; the faker stares straight ahead.

tasks.instruction: Freeze mid-wave, like you waved at someone who wasn't waving at you.
tasks.fakerTrap: The joke is the dying wave — fingers curling in slow shame — and the faker holds a happy full wave with no regret in it.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand if you clapped the last time your plane landed.
tasks.fakerTrap: Real claps come with a sheepish look around the pod; the faker mirrors the hand but not the embarrassment.

tasks.instruction: Point at the person most likely to know a good swimming spot.
tasks.fakerTrap: Locals point with a specific person and a specific beach in mind; the faker can't survive the 'okay, where?' that follows.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers behind your head for how many cups of coffee you had today.
tasks.fakerTrap: The behind-the-head placement is the instruction — fingers held out front is an instant miss no matter the count.

tasks.instruction: Pose like a garden gnome who has seen too much.
tasks.fakerTrap: Everyone else lands the same combination of cheerful stance and haunted eyes; the faker manages one or the other, never both.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand if you talked to a pet like a coworker today.
tasks.fakerTrap: Genuine hands go up mid-chuckle before anyone else moves; hesitation on this one reads as scanning the room.

tasks.instruction: Point at whoever you'd want on your trivia team.
tasks.fakerTrap: Insiders pick fast and diverge honestly; the faker's vote lands wherever fingers already are, and it lands last.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for how many tabs are open on your phone right now, capped at ten.
tasks.fakerTrap: The cap is the joke — insiders who blow past it flash all ten with a guilty laugh, while the faker offers a modest four with no story.

tasks.instruction: Strike the lunge of someone who almost slipped on ice but saved it.
tasks.fakerTrap: The save has a signature — arms out, one leg rigid, face mid-gasp — and a faker's version looks like a calm yoga warrior pose.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand, and with the other hand point toward the lake from here.
tasks.fakerTrap: Locals point the same direction without thinking; the faker either stalls or confidently points at a sandwich shop.

tasks.instruction: Point with both hands at two different people.
tasks.fakerTrap: Everyone else splits their hands immediately; a faker starting with one finger and hastily adding the second is mid-copy.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for the most layers you wore on one day last February.
tasks.fakerTrap: Local answers cluster high and specific; a faker's polite three layers reads like someone who's never met February here.

tasks.instruction: Pose like you're following an amazing smell from a food cart.
tasks.fakerTrap: The nose leads and the whole body follows on a slow lean; a faker sniffs in place with no drift.

tasks.instruction: Raise your left hand only.
tasks.fakerTrap: Simple, but the faker has to check which arm the room used before committing — watch for the one hand that switches arms mid-raise.

tasks.instruction: Point at whoever's phone is probably closest to dying.
tasks.fakerTrap: It's verifiable on the spot — insiders point at the person who's been hunting an outlet all night; the faker points at random.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers on both hands for how many weddings you've danced at.
tasks.fakerTrap: The both-hands format is the instruction — one raised hand is wrong no matter what number it shows.

tasks.instruction: Freeze like a squirrel who just got spotted.
tasks.fakerTrap: The right move is a total freeze mid-gesture, exactly as you were — the faker composes a cute squirrel pose, which is exactly wrong.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand if you hummed a song you don't even like today.
tasks.fakerTrap: The honest reaction is a groan of self-recognition on the way up; a silent, neutral raise stands out.

tasks.instruction: Point at the person most likely to own a canoe.
tasks.fakerTrap: The pod's read converges fast on flannel and forearms; a faker's cold guess scatters, and their 'why them?' has no answer.

tasks.instruction: Hold up fingers for how many Lake Champlain swims you've had this year, then wiggle them if the water was cold.
tasks.fakerTrap: The wiggle is a hidden second beat — everyone's fingers suddenly start moving and the faker doesn't know why.

tasks.instruction: Pose like you're chasing one bar of cell service on a mountain.
tasks.fakerTrap: The phone goes high and the body goes up on tiptoe with it, face pleading; the faker holds the phone at texting height.

tasks.instruction: Raise your hand if you've ever said "it's not the cold, it's the wind."
tasks.fakerTrap: Locals raise while half-mouthing the phrase involuntarily; the faker has no idea what everyone is suddenly muttering.

tasks.instruction: Point at the newest pair of shoes in the pod.
tasks.fakerTrap: Another look-down-first task — pointing before scanning a single pair of feet is the mark of a copier.
